title: Dashboard MCP Tool Contract
description: The tool surface YOUR server exposes to client agents. They fill these schemas and call the tool; you process the call into Apache Superset charts + a dashboard and return a URL. Naming/auth conventions follow the superset.sh MCP doc format (snake_case tool names, OAuth 2.1 or 'Bearer sk_live_...' API key, JSON input/output).

tools.name: dashboard_generate
tools.description: Generate a dashboard from one or more chart specs and return a shareable URL. This is the primary tool — a client describes the charts it wants in plain structured fields and gets back a dashboard URL (plus optional embed credentials).

title.description: Dashboard title shown to the end user.

dataset.description: Default data source for charts that don't override it. Either a numeric Superset dataset id, or a name your server resolves to one.

layout_columns.description: Charts per row in the dashboard grid.

embed.description: If present, server enables embedding and returns embed_uuid + guest_token.

allowed_domains.description: Domains permitted to iframe-embed the dashboard.

row_level_security.description: Optional RLS clauses scoping data per requesting user.

tools.name: chart_data_query
tools.description: Run a single chart's query and return the raw rows WITHOUT building a dashboard. Use when the client wants to render the data itself instead of receiving a URL.

tools.name: datasets_list
tools.description: List the datasets available to query, so a client can discover valid `dataset` ids and the columns/metrics it can put in a ChartSpec.

search.description: Optional free-text filter on dataset name.

tools.name: chart_embed_links
tools.description: Create individual charts and return a per-chart embed URL plus ready-to-paste iframe HTML for each. Use this instead of dashboard_generate when the client wants to place individual charts inside their own UI rather than open a full Superset dashboard.

charts.description: One ChartSpec per chart. Same schema as dashboard_generate.

dataset.description: Default dataset id or name for charts that do not override it.

embed_url.description: Direct URL to the chart (no login needed via proxy).

ChartSpec.title: ChartSpec
ChartSpec.description: What a client fills to describe ONE chart. Deliberately flat and Superset-agnostic — no internal Superset params required.

dataset.description: Override the dashboard default dataset for this chart.

metrics.description: Measures to plot (e.g. 'total_amount', 'count'). Single-metric charts use the first.

time_column.description: Time axis column. Required for time-series chart types.

filters.description: Simple filters; server converts to Superset filter syntax.

value.description: Value or list. Omit for IS NULL / IS NOT NULL.

options.description: Optional per-type extras: subheader (big_number), min/max (gauge), bins (histogram), rows/pivot_columns/aggregate (pivot_table), country_format (world_map).

DashboardResult.title: DashboardResult
DashboardResult.description: What your server returns to the client after dashboard_generate.

dashboard_url.description: Send THIS to the end user. Clicking renders the dashboard.

standalone_url.description: Chrome-less URL suited for iframe embedding.

embed_uuid.description: Present only if embed.allowed_domains was supplied.

guest_token.description: Short-lived token for the Embedded SDK. Present only if embedding enabled.
